revision_note: v1 had ten classes. A 348-conversation inter-rater study (claude-sonnet-5 vs gemini-3.5-flash) showed the raters themselves agreed only 84% of the time, with disagreement concentrated among information_seeking, homework_study, personal_advice, writing_editing and business_professional. Those were merged into two classes; agreement on the merged taxonomy is 87%.

classes.name: coding
classes.definition: Writing, fixing, explaining, or converting code, scripts, SQL, configs, or software errors.

classes.name: questions
classes.definition: Asking for information, explanations, definitions, comparisons, recommendations, or advice, whether for school, work, or the person's own life. Merges v1 information_seeking, homework_study, and personal_advice, which raters could not separate consistently.

classes.name: writing_and_business
classes.definition: Drafting, rewriting, summarizing, or proofreading text of any kind: emails, essays, posts, reports, marketing copy, product descriptions, resumes, business plans, or workplace documents. Merges v1 writing_editing and business_professional.

classes.name: creative_roleplay
classes.definition: Fiction, poems, stories, character roleplay, dialogue, or interactive scenarios.

classes.name: image_prompting
classes.definition: Generating or refining prompts for image models such as Midjourney or Stable Diffusion, or describing images to generate.

classes.name: translation
classes.definition: Translating text between languages, or asking about grammar, vocabulary, or usage in another language.

classes.name: other
classes.definition: Anything else: greetings, tests of the assistant, gibberish, or requests that fit no class above.
